event_chain.summary: Pretexting as IT worker to obtain employee credentials
Use of stolen creds on cloud app; data exported

summary: On August 24, 2026 an unauthorized individual posing as a Marathon Health IT worker tricked an employee into disclosing their credentials, used them to access a cloud-hosted application, and exported personal and health information within a few hours. Marathon Health, an Indianapolis-based provider of employer-sponsored on-site and near-site primary care centers, identified the suspicious account activity the same day and disabled the account. About 5.7 million individuals (5,684,735 per the Texas AG filing) were affected; data included names, contact information, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, medical and health insurance information.
